quarterly_data.quarter: Axcelis press release: Axcelis to Build New Manufacturing Facility in Pyeongtaek, (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Axcelis plans to invest $35 million to build a new ion implantation equipment manufacturing facility in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, Korea: approximately 200,000 square feet of gross floor area integrating warehousing, Class 1,000 and Class 10,000 cleanrooms and a training center. Groundbreaking is set for October 20, 2026 and production is scheduled to commence in the second half of 2028. CEO Russell Low: the facility builds on Axcelis' established presence in Korea and 'will enhance our ability to support growing global demand for semiconductors'.
quarterly_data.figure: $35 million; approximately 200,000 square feet; groundbreaking October 20, 2026; production second half of 2028
